analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 구간 진입, ADX 추세 미형성
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI entering oversold, ADX no trend
analysis.reason:
RSI 38.7로 과매도 구간 진입, 5일 저가 129.57이 20일 저가 127.65 상회하며 Higher Low 패턴 형성. ADX 19.2로 추세 미형성 상태에서 변동성 확대 가능성.
주봉 RSI 43.6, MACD 히스토그램 -3.2991로 약세 구간 지속. 일봉 지표 반등 신호 있으나 주봉 지표 약세로 상충.
시장 전체 QQQ -1.6% 하락 중으로 매수 진입 부담.
analysis.reasonEn:
RSI at 38.7 entering oversold territory, with a 5-day low of $129.57 above the 20-day low of $127.65 forming a Higher Low pattern. ADX at 19.2 indicates no trend formation, suggesting potential for increased volatility.
Weekly RSI at 43.6 and MACD histogram at -3.2991 show continued weakness. Daily indicators show signs of rebound, but this conflicts with the weaker weekly indicators.
The broader market (QQQ) is down 1.6%, adding to the caution for new entries.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 RSI 43.6, MACD 히스토그램 -3.2991로 약세이나 일봉 RSI 과매도 탈출 시도 및 Higher Low 패턴으로 일봉 신호 우선
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 43.6 and MACD histogram at -3.2991 indicate weakness, but daily RSI attempts to exit oversold and a Higher Low pattern suggest prioritizing daily signals.

[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($129.21) + 근거 (볼린저 하단, 5일 저가 기반)

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low 형성) + 회복 신호 가능성
[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 관망 조건: 일봉 지표 반등 확인 및 주봉 지표 개선
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($130.20) vs SMA5 ($137.40) / SMA20 ($141.95) / SMA50 ($146.72): Below short-term/mid-term trends, diagnosing a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($146.28) / SMA200 ($134.34): Below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (59.7%) + Approaching historical low range at current price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.9→38.7) + Diagnosing entry into oversold territory + Continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.5771→-0.5734) + Diagnosing improvement + Weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $127.70) + Bandwidth at 20.07%, indicating expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($129.21) + Basis (Lower Bollinger Band, 5-day low based).
· Swing resistance ($145.93) + Potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low formed) + Possibility of recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.09x) + Normal confidence level for price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Conditions for entry/wait: Confirmation of daily indicator rebound and improvement in weekly indicators.
